acceptanceCriteria: The refusal and the MIXED report name the drifting paths (bounded list) and state that global excludes are not honoured, with the fix (tracked .gitignore or .git/info/exclude).
Tests cover a path ignored only by core.excludesFile.
body: Found by the 2026-10-20 read-only Beamfall setup review (corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676; evidence under the session scratchpad beamfall-review/). Corvint ignores global excludes by design (decision 0158, sanitizedGitEnvironment in internal/genesis/repository.go). In beamfall-apple-ui, beamfall-android-ui and beamfall-windows, .claude/settings.local.json is ignored only via ~/.config/git/ignore, so `overview` refuses with "dirty worktree or status drift" (internal/genesis/guidance.go:111-135) without saying which path or why.
